original_high_level_goal.name: Register Hospitals and Manage Information
original_high_level_goal.description: Facilitate the registration of hospitals and the management of their information, including location and available bed counts, to ensure accurate and up-to-date data for healthcare access.

actor.name: Hospital Administrators
actor.description: Personnel responsible for managing hospital operations and resources.

branch_001.reconstructed_high_level_goal: Facilitate effective management of hospital resources and information by hospital administrators.
branch_001.rationale: Grounding: The documentation explicitly lists registering hospitals and managing their information (location, beds) as a primary functionality to enhance SUS efficiency. The reconstructed HLG accurately summarizes this specific functional intention regarding hospital resource and information management. Alignment: The reconstructed HLG preserves the actor (Hospital Administrators) and the core functional objective of managing hospital information and resources. Although it generalizes 'registration' and specific data points into 'resources and information', the fundamental WHY-level intention remains aligned with the parent.

original_high_level_goal.name: Identify Nearest Hospital
original_high_level_goal.description: Provide functionality to identify the nearest hospital for patients based on their location and current bed availability, ensuring timely access to healthcare services.

actor.name: Patients
actor.description: Individuals seeking healthcare services within the public health system.

branch_002.reconstructed_high_level_goal: Facilitate timely access to healthcare services for patients by providing information on hospital proximity and bed availability.
branch_002.rationale: Grounding: The documentation explicitly lists identifying the nearest hospital based on location and bed availability as a key functionality to ensure timely access. The reconstructed HLG accurately captures this specific functional intention and its underlying purpose. Alignment: The reconstructed HLG accurately preserves the core functional intention of identifying the nearest hospital based on location and bed availability to ensure timely access. It maintains the same actor perspective (patients) and intended outcome as the parent HLG.

original_high_level_goal.name: Provide Detailed Information on Hospital Stocks and Patient Records
original_high_level_goal.description: Ensure that detailed information about hospital stocks and patient records is accessible to authorized personnel for better decision-making and resource management.
